title: Migrate synchronous Python requests to async httpx
description: A Python HTTP client uses the synchronous `requests` library. Migrate it to async `httpx` with proper async/await. Tests use pytest-asyncio. Exercises migration category and async Python patterns.

files.test_client.py:
"""Tests using httpx.AsyncClient as mock."""
import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
import httpx
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

from client import fetch_user, fetch_posts, create_post


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_fetch_user():
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.json.return_value = {"id": 1, "name": "Alice", "email": "alice@example.com"}
    mock_response.raise_for_status = MagicMock()

    with patch("client.httpx.AsyncClient") as mock_client_cls:
        mock_client = AsyncMock()
        mock_client.__aenter__ = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_client)
        mock_client.__aexit__ = AsyncMock(return_value=False)
        mock_client.get = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_response)
        mock_client_cls.return_value = mock_client

        result = await fetch_user("http://api.test", 1)
        assert result["name"] == "Alice"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_fetch_posts():
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.json.return_value = [{"id": 1, "title": "Post 1", "userId": 1}]
    mock_response.raise_for_status = MagicMock()

    with patch("client.httpx.AsyncClient") as mock_client_cls:
        mock_client = AsyncMock()
        mock_client.__aenter__ = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_client)
        mock_client.__aexit__ = AsyncMock(return_value=False)
        mock_client.get = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_response)
        mock_client_cls.return_value = mock_client

        result = await fetch_posts("http://api.test", 1)
        assert len(result) == 1
        assert result[0]["title"] == "Post 1"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_post():
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.json.return_value = {"id": 101, "title": "New", "body": "Body", "userId": 1}
    mock_response.raise_for_status = MagicMock()

    with patch("client.httpx.AsyncClient") as mock_client_cls:
        mock_client = AsyncMock()
        mock_client.__aenter__ = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_client)
        mock_client.__aexit__ = AsyncMock(return_value=False)
        mock_client.post = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_response)
        mock_client_cls.return_value = mock_client

        result = await create_post("http://api.test", "New", "Body", 1)
        assert result["id"] == 101

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate client.py from synchronous `requests` to async `httpx`.

The test file already uses `httpx.AsyncClient` as the mock target. You need to:
1. Replace `import requests` with `import httpx`
2. Make all three functions async (`async def`)
3. Use `async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:` for HTTP calls
4. Use `await client.get(...)` and `await client.post(...)`

Run `pytest test_client.py -v --rootdir=. --override-ini=asyncio_mode=auto` to verify all 3 tests pass. Do NOT modify pyproject.toml.
